content.text: words to the end of the world, Ps. 19:4 (Rom. 10:18). ends of the world shall remember, Ps. 22:27. world is mine, Ps. 50:12. world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved, Ps. 93:1 (96:10). with righteousness shall he judge the world, Ps. 98:9. hath set the world in their heart, Eccl. 3:11. I will punish the world for their evil, Isa. 13:11 (2 Ne. 23:11). world languisheth and fadeth away, Isa. 24:4.

I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world, Matt. 28:20. receive … in the world to come eternal life, Mark 10:30 (Luke 18:30). Go ye into all the world, and preach, Mark 16:15 (Morm. 9:22; D&C 84:62). all the world should be taxed, Luke 2:1. He was in the world, and the world was made by him, John 1:10. Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world, John 1:29. God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, John 3:16. Christ, the Saviour of the world, John 4:42. world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, John 7:7. I am the light of the world, John 8:12 (9:5; Mosiah 16:9; Alma 38:9; 3 Ne. 9:18; 11:11; Ether 4:12; D&C 10:70). I am not of this world, John 8:23. I came not to judge the world, but to save the world, John 12:47. loved his own which were in the world, John 13:1. If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before, John 15:18. In the world ye shall have tribulation, John 16:33. I pray for them: I pray not for the world, John 17:9. I am no more in the world, John 17:11. they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world, John 17:14. I pray not that thou … take them out of the world, John 17:15. world may believe that thou hast sent me, John 17:21. My kingdom is not of this world, John 18:36. have turned the world upside down, Acts 17:6. God that made the world and all things therein, Acts 17:24. world may become guilty before God, Rom. 3:19. by one man sin entered into the world, Rom. 5:12. if the fall of them be the riches of the world, Rom. 11:12. be not conformed to this world, Rom. 12:2. world by wisdom knew not God, 1 Cor. 1:21 (2:6). wisdom of this world is foolishness with God, 1 Cor. 3:19. we are made a spectacle unto the world, 1 Cor. 4:9. not altogether with the fornicators of this world, 1 Cor. 5:10. saints shall judge the world, 1 Cor. 6:2. they that use this world, as not abusing it, 1 Cor. 7:31. God … reconciling the world unto himself, 2 Cor. 5:19. Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world, Gal. 6:14. every name that is named, not only in this world, Eph. 1:21. ye walked according to the course of this world, Eph. 2:2. world without end, Eph. 3:21 (D&C 76:112). against the rulers of the darkness of this world, Eph. 6:12. forsaken me, having loved this present world, 2 Tim. 4:10. his Son … by whom also he made the worlds, Heb. 1:2. tasted … the powers of the world to come, Heb. 6:5. worlds were framed by the word of God, Heb. 11:3. Of whom the world was not worthy, Heb. 11:38. to keep himself unspotted from the world, James 1:27. friendship of the world is enmity with God, James 4:4. spared not the old world, 2 Pet. 2:5. propitiation … for the sins of the whole world, 1 Jn. 2:2. things which are pleasing unto the world I do not write, 1 Ne. 6:5. spacious field, as if it had been a world, 1 Ne. 8:20. spacious building was the pride of the world, 1 Ne. 11:36. built up to become popular in the eyes of the world, 1 Ne. 22:23. who have endured the crosses of the world, 2 Ne. 9:18. rich as to the things of the world, 2 Ne. 9:30. I will punish the world for evil, 2 Ne. 23:11. Son of God into the spirit world, D&C 138:16. his sojourn in the world of spirits, D&C 138:36.

beheld the world upon which he was created, Moses 1:8. worlds without number have I created, Moses 1:33. enjoy the words of eternal life in this world, and eternal life in the world to come, Moses 6:59.
